## SECTION 1: FOUNDRY ARCHITECTURE, MOLD WAIVER POLICY & COMPLIANCE STANDARDS
================================================================================

### 1.1 Transparent Custom Tooling & Mold Waiver Policy
MedalPinSupply.com custom-manufactures **158 core metal craft specifications** strictly to each buyer’s logo artwork (no pre-made off-the-shelf models or stock inventory) in Zhongshan Xiaolan, combining rapid pre-press vector proofing (`12 hours`), clear MOQ minimums (`300 pcs` for custom pins & race medals; `50–200 pcs` for challenge coins, keychains, magnets & hardware), and automatic tooling fee waivers:
- **Custom Tooling Fees & Bulk Threshold Waivers**: Custom 2D stamping dies (`$45 – $85 USD`) and plate setups (`$35`) are automatically **waived 100% at 500+ pcs** on lapel pins, trolley coins, cufflinks, dog tags, and keychains (`300+ pcs` on embroidered patches).
- **3D Sculpted Zinc Die-Casting Molds (`$95 – $150 USD`)**: Automatically **waived 100%** at **1,000+ pcs** for 3D marathon medals, military challenge coins, police shields, and trophy belt buckles.
- **3-Year Free Reorder Die Storage (`$0 Reorder Tooling`)**: All paid custom client dies are archived cleanly in our Zhongshan vault for **3 years**, so annual race or corporate reorders cost `$0.00` in setup fees.
- **Split-Plating On One Shared Die**: Race directors and HR directors can run Gold, Silver, and Bronze platings (1st/2nd/3rd place awards or 1/5/10-year service milestones) across a single cut die while counting combined quantity toward the waiver threshold.

### 1.2 In-House Stamping, Enamel, Electroplating & Export Compliance Stack
- **Forming & Casting Lines**: CNC steel die engraving, **300T–800T hydraulic stamping presses** for copper/brass/iron coins & cloisonne badges, and hot-chamber **Zamak #3 zinc alloy die-casting** machines for multi-level 3D medals & cut-outs.
- **Enamel & Specialty Color Systems**: Kiln-fired synthetic cloisonne hard enamel (stone-polished completely flat), Pantone-calibrated soft enamel ink dispensing, crystal clear protective epoxy lenses, glitter, strontium aluminate glow-in-the-dark fills, translucent stained-glass, CMYK litho offset, and photo-etched `0.8mm` brass.
- **12 Rack Electroplating Finishes**: Shiny Gold, Shiny Nickel, Chrome, Rose Gold, Satin Gold, Black Nickel, Matte Black Dye, Matte Copper, plus Hand-Relieved Antique Bronze/Brass/Silver/Pewter and two-tone masked dual plating.
- **Certified Global Safety Compliance**:
  1. **US CPSIA & California Proposition 65**: Virgin low-lead Zamak #3, C26800 brass, copper, iron & SUS304 substrates holding total lead strictly `< 90 ppm`.
  2. **EU EN71-3 & 6P/7P Non-Phthalate**: Enamels, PVC morale patches, and rubber pin clutches formulated free of regulated phthalates and toxic heavy-metal migration.
  3. **EU REACH Annex XVII & EN 1811**: Nickel-free copper underplated gold/rose/palladium baths testing below `< 0.5 µg/cm²/wk` nickel release.
  4. **Hardware Pull-Force & Pre-Shipment QC**: Silver-brazed pin spurs pull-tested to `> 4.5 kg`, breakaway marathon safety clasps on youth ribbons, and 100% cosmetic enamel/bezel inspection before carton sealing.

### Guide #1: True 3D Relief Sculpting vs. 2D Multi-Level Die-Casting: Mold Engraving & Shading Engineering
- **Canonical URL**: https://medalpinsupply.com/insights/3d-relief-sculpting-vs-2d-multi-level-die-casting-mold-engineering
- **Category**: Materials & Manufacturing | **Reading Time**: 10 min read | **Updated**: 2026-11-25
- **Executive Summary**: Understand how CNC 3D Z-axis sculpting differs from stepped 2D metal layers on custom marathon medals, challenge coins, and western belt buckles.

#### 1. Engineering Overview: 3D Relief Sculpting vs 2D Multi-Level Molds

Direct Answer: CNC 3D Z-axis sculpting carves continuous 0.8mm–2.5mm multi-plane contours for faces, skylines, and mascots, while stepped 2D multi-level molds sharpen tiered corporate crests and text at 15%–20% lower mold cost.

Wholesale buyers access factory-direct pricing from $0.62 to $1.55/pc on custom options like Custom 3D Zinc Alloy Die-Cast Lapel Pins. Every custom production run includes complimentary 12-hour vector proofs.

At our Zhongshan Xiaolan metalworking foundry, production begins with 1:1 Pantone die-line layouts before steel cutting starts. Pre-production samples ship in 7–10 Days so procurement teams confirm weight and finish luster early.

When teams evaluate crafts across Custom Race Medals & Medallions, Custom Challenge Coins, and Executive Cufflinks & Belt Buckles, subtle shifts in alloy thickness and plating adhesion affect land-cost efficiency.

Here is what separates reliable custom tooling from cheap shortcuts:

Pin, medal, and coin unit economics depend on relief depth, die waiver volume breaks, and rear clasp or attachment geometry.

Below, we benchmark factory specifications across Custom 3D Spin-Cast Pewter Lapel Pins, Custom 3D Die-Cast Marathon Finisher Medals, and Custom Triathlon & Cycling Heavyweight Medals.

#### 3. 3D Relief Sculpting vs 2D Multi-Level Molds — Substrate Metallurgy, Electroplating & Workflow

The engineering principle is straightforward: substrate ductility governs detail sharpness. Flat two-dimensional crests stamp crisply in solid brass or iron, whereas deep sculpted forms flow cleanly in hot-chamber Zamak #3 zinc.

Every batch passes six quality checkpoints between blanking and export boxing. Automated optical screening isolates surface pitting or soldering voids before attachment assembly begins.

##### Core Fabrication Stages & Material Pairing

  - Die-Struck C26000 Brass & Iron: Strike razor-sharp coin rims, 0.15mm borders, and flush stone-polished cloisonne on Custom Soft Enamel 5K & 10K Running Medals and Custom Rotating Spinner Race Medals.

  - Zamak #3 Hot-Chamber 3D Casting: Inject crisp multi-level relief, inner cut-out windows, and spinner pivots across Custom Cut-Out Hollow Zinc Alloy Sports Medals and Custom Bottle Opener Finisher Medals.

  - Photo-Etched & Offset Litho Imaging: Hold thin 0.35mm filigree silhouettes or CMYK photo gradients under clear domes on Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals and Custom Translucent Stained-Glass Enamel Medals.

  - 12 Electroplating & Dye Coats: Finish pieces in 18K gold, rhodium silver, mirror black nickel, antique bronze, or matte dye across Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Night Run Medals and Custom Gold Silver Bronze Antique Award Medals.

Why match specific crafts instead of defaulting to one base alloy?

Selecting hydraulic die-struck stamping for crisp flat enamel or molten Zamak #3 die-casting for 3D depth locks yield quality from the first strike. Inspecting physical strikes across textures ensures balanced pocket heft and clean visual borders before full production stamping starts.

#### 4. Tooling Economics, Retail Packaging & Pre-Shipment Milestones (3D Relief Sculpting vs 2D Multi-Level Molds)

Mounting finished pieces on Custom Printed Retail Backing Cards for Enamel Pins prepares retail hooks cleanly before air courier dispatch.

Commemorative editions paired with Clear Acrylic Challenge Coin Capsules & Display Stands, Custom Velvet Presentation Boxes (Medals, Coins & Cufflinks), or Custom Leatherette & Wooden Deluxe Award Cases prevent transit scuffing.

#### 5. Field Failure Prevention & Pre-Shipment Inspection Protocol (3D Relief Sculpting vs 2D Multi-Level Molds)

Wholesale buyers hit avoidable enamel cross-bleeding, brittle rear post snaps, or dull recessed plating when artwork wall clearances drop below factory minimums before engraving.

Our tooling desk enforces >= 0.15mm metal walls on pins (>= 0.35mm on sculpted coins) during free 12-hour proofs and verifies XRF lead safety on every melt.

##### Mandatory Foundry QC Checkpoints Before Bulk Release

  - Rear Post Silver Brazing Audit: High-torque soldering secures butterfly spurs above 25N pull force on Custom Military 3D Die-Struck Brass Challenge Coins and Custom 3D Zinc Alloy Die-Cast Keychains.

  - Pantone Delta-E Metered Filling: Precision dispensers fill recessed cavities prior to 180°C kiln baking across Custom Cut-Out Hollow Zinc Alloy Sports Medals and Custom Bottle Opener Finisher Medals.

  - Electrophoretic Lacquer Sealing: Protective clear coats block oxidation across antique and mirror plating on Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Night Run Medals and Custom Gold Silver Bronze Antique Award Medals.

  - Individually Sealed Tray Packing: Separate polybags and divider inserts stop metal-on-metal rub throughout express DDP air transit.

#### 3. Five Engineering Cost Drivers: Size, 3D Sculpting, Dual Plating & Edge Cuts

When a purchasing manager requests a quote for Custom Hard Enamel Law Enforcement Challenge Coins versus standard bronze coins, five technical specifications explain every cent of price variance.

Understanding these five levers allows creative directors to keep premium tactile weight while stripping unnecessary secondary hand-labor steps out of the factory routing sheet.

  - 1. Diameter & Thickness Volume (Metal Mass): Stepping up from 1.75" (44.5mm, 42–48g) to 2.0" (50.8mm, 54–64g) increases raw C26000 brass or Zamak #3 metal mass by roughly 32%, typically adding $0.25–$0.45/pc before plating.

  - 2. 2D Die-Struck vs. 3D Sculpted CNC Relief: Flat multi-level 2D artwork strikes fast in steel dies; deep sculpted busts or domed architecture on Custom Cut-Out Shape & Shield Challenge Coins require multi-axis CNC EDM carving ($110–$125 one-time mold) and slower cycle cooling.

  - 3. Two-Tone Selective Electroplating Masking: Pairing mirror gold lettering with antique nickel fields on Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins adds manual lacquer-resist painting and secondary plating tank immersion ($0.35–$0.60/pc adder).

  - 4. CNC Diamond-Cut Edge & Rim Turning: Milling rope, oblique, wave, spur, or crosscut rims on Custom Diamond-Cut & Rope-Edge Challenge Coins adds secondary lathe indexing per coin edge ($0.15–$0.30/pc depending on rim complexity).

  - 5. Rotary Laser Numbering & Specialty Pigments: Individual galvo fiber serialization (`001/500`) on Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins or phosphorescent glow infills on Custom Glow-in-the-Dark & Translucent Enamel Coins add batch handling charges of $0.10–$0.22/pc.

Does heavy custom framing or institutional insignia pricing follow the same die curve?

Yes. Fraternal designs like Custom Masonic, Fraternal & Lodge Challenge Coins share identical mold amortization ($110 waived at 1,000+ pcs), while uniform chest hardware like Custom 3D Curved Shield Police & Security Badges add dome-forming and silver-brazed safety catches.

#### 5. How Procurement Teams Cut Custom Challenge Coin Cost by 18%–35% Without Losing Heft

Experienced military units, foundations, and branding agencies consistently hit sub-$1.65 landed coin budgets by optimizing die utilization before approving vector production files.

Follow these four engineering rules on your next wholesale quote to eliminate avoidable surcharges while preserving authentic 3.5mm pocket weight:

  - Batch Multi-Color Editions onto One Die: Strike 300 antique silver coins and 200 antique bronze coins from the same sculpted master mold—crossing 1,000 total units waives the $115–$125 custom die outright.

  - Default to 1.75" (44.5mm) Instead of 2.0" When Appropriate: Stepping down 6mm in diameter saves up to 30% on brass alloy weight and international air freight per shipment without compromising legibility.

  - Choose Antiqued Relief Over Selective Dual-Plating: Hand-relieved antique bronze or silver creates rich metallic depth on antique commemorative coins at $0.40–$0.55/pc less than double masking.

  - Pre-Order Capsulated Kits Direct from Factory: Pairing coins directly with acrylic capsules at the Zhongshan packing line saves downstream fulfillment assembly labor and protects mirror surfaces in transit.

#### 3. Embroidered vs Woven & Soft PVC Patches — Substrate Metallurgy, Electroplating & Workflow

The engineering principle is straightforward: substrate ductility governs detail sharpness. Flat two-dimensional crests stamp crisply in solid brass or iron, whereas deep sculpted forms flow cleanly in hot-chamber Zamak #3 zinc.

Every batch passes six quality checkpoints between blanking and export boxing. Automated optical screening isolates surface pitting or soldering voids before attachment assembly begins.

##### Core Fabrication Stages & Material Pairing

  - Threaded, Woven & 3D PVC Patches: Balance crisp 1.5mm woven lettering against waterproof molded rubber crests in Custom Velvet Presentation Boxes (Medals, Coins & Cufflinks) and Clear Acrylic Challenge Coin Capsules & Display Stands.

  - Precision Clutch & Backing Selection: Match brass butterfly clasps, spring locks, or magnets across Custom Printed Retail Backing Cards for Enamel Pins and Custom Leatherette & Wooden Deluxe Award Cases.

  - Foundry-Mounted Retail Cards & Boxes: Assemble 350–400gsm Euro-slot cards, acrylic capsules, and velvet cases onto Custom 3D Curved Shield Police & Security Badges and Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges.

  - CPSIA, Prop 65 & REACH Certification: Screen incoming brass, Zamak #3, pigments, and PVC lots via Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges and Custom Police Badges with Recessed Leather Belt Clip.

Why match specific crafts instead of defaulting to one base alloy?

Pre-mounting finished hardware onto printed backing cards or inside coin capsules at our Zhongshan packing floor eliminates third-party domestic kitting fees. Inspecting physical strikes across textures ensures balanced pocket heft and clean visual borders before full production stamping starts.

#### 5. Field Failure Prevention & Pre-Shipment Inspection Protocol (Embroidered vs Woven & Soft PVC Patches)

  - Rear Post Silver Brazing Audit: High-torque soldering secures butterfly spurs above 25N pull force on Custom Cut-Out Shape & Shield Challenge Coins and Custom 3D Zinc Alloy Die-Cast Keychains.

  - Pantone Delta-E Metered Filling: Precision dispensers fill recessed cavities prior to 180°C kiln baking across Custom Rotating Spinner Race Medals and Custom Bottle Opener Finisher Medals.

  - Electrophoretic Lacquer Sealing: Protective clear coats block oxidation across antique and mirror plating on Custom Triathlon & Cycling Heavyweight Medals and Custom Gold Silver Bronze Antique Award Medals.

  - Individually Sealed Tray Packing: Separate polybags and divider inserts stop metal-on-metal rub throughout express DDP air transit.

  - Rotary Edge Numbering & Fasteners: Index 001/500 edition serials or solder heavy safety catches and leather holsters on Custom Diamond-Cut & Rope-Edge Challenge Coins and Custom Spinner Center Challenge Coins.

### Guide #37: Photo-Etched Brass vs. Offset CMYK & Silk-Screen Printed Pins: Resolving Fine Lines & Gradients
- **Canonical URL**: https://medalpinsupply.com/insights/photo-etched-brass-vs-offset-printed-silk-screen-lapel-pins
- **Category**: Materials & Manufacturing | **Reading Time**: 10 min read | **Updated**: 2026-11-25
- **Executive Summary**: Choose between 0.8mm photo-etched brass, CMYK offset litho epoxy domes, and spot silk-screen printing for intricate gradients and thin line art.

#### 1. Engineering Overview: Photo-Etched Brass vs Offset Printed Pins

Direct Answer: Acid photo-etched 0.8mm brass ($0.38–$1.05/pc) resolves intricate thin-line filigree without stamping burrs, whereas CMYK offset litho printing under clear epoxy domes reproduces photographic portraits and continuous gradients starting at 300 pcs MOQ.

Wholesale buyers access factory-direct pricing from $0.38 to $1.05/pc on custom options like Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Pins. Every custom production run includes complimentary 12-hour vector proofs.

At our Zhongshan Xiaolan metalworking foundry, production begins with 1:1 Pantone die-line layouts before steel cutting starts. Pre-production samples ship in 7–10 Days so procurement teams confirm weight and finish luster early.

When teams evaluate crafts across Custom Enamel & Lapel Pins and Metal Bookmarks, Openers & Souvenirs, subtle shifts in alloy thickness and plating adhesion affect land-cost efficiency.

##### Core Fabrication Stages & Material Pairing

  - Photo-Etched & Offset Litho Imaging: Hold thin 0.35mm filigree silhouettes or CMYK photo gradients under clear domes on Custom Die-Struck Antique Brass Lapel Pins (No Color) and Custom Offset Printed Lapel Pins (Full-Color Photo).

  - 12 Electroplating & Dye Coats: Finish pieces in 18K gold, rhodium silver, mirror black nickel, antique bronze, or matte dye across Custom Silk-Screen Printed Metal Lapel Pins and Custom 3D Zinc Alloy Die-Cast Lapel Pins.

Why match specific crafts instead of defaulting to one base alloy?

Selecting hydraulic die-struck stamping for crisp flat enamel or molten Zamak #3 die-casting for 3D depth locks yield quality from the first strike. Inspecting physical strikes across textures ensures balanced pocket heft and clean visual borders before full production stamping starts.

  - Individually Sealed Tray Packing: Separate polybags and divider inserts stop metal-on-metal rub throughout express DDP air transit.

#### 5. Field Failure Prevention & Pre-Shipment Inspection Protocol (Zinc Alloy vs Die-Struck Brass & Iron Craft Cost)

##### Mandatory Foundry QC Checkpoints Before Bulk Release

  - Pantone Delta-E Metered Filling: Precision dispensers fill recessed cavities prior to 180°C kiln baking across Custom Soft Enamel Pins with Clear Epoxy Dome and Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Pins.

  - Electrophoretic Lacquer Sealing: Protective clear coats block oxidation across antique and mirror plating on Custom 3D Spin-Cast Pewter Lapel Pins and Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins.

  - Individually Sealed Tray Packing: Separate polybags and divider inserts stop metal-on-metal rub throughout express DDP air transit.
